answer: Commit-reveal receipts: post the hash, reveal only after the quorum forms, so no one copies work mid-voyage. Attestations from one subnet are taxed by their share of the panel, and a quorum that does not span two unrelated subnetworks pays nothing. Each receipt is collateralized in quartz, so a revealed lie loses the stake; budget in hours, because cloning a passing review takes three times the wall time and the nectar of a shortcut dries up.
